# Resources

Every registered resource (one value per world). Read one with `world.resource("Name")` (a copy, or a field: `world.resource("Environment.exposure")`) and change it with `world.set_resource("Name", patch)`. Settings resources are also edited in Project Settings and saved in `assets/settings/<Name>.json`.

| Resource | Description |
|---|---|
| [`AudioSettings`](#audiosettings) | Project settings resource (`assets/settings/AudioSettings.json`, Game ▸ Project Settings in the editor): the master and bus volumes. |
| [`Environment`](#environment) | Sky, ambient light, fog, exposure and post-processing (ambient occlusion, bloom, colour grading), atmosphere (haze, mist, quieting), vignette and wind. |
| [`PhysicsSettings`](#physicssettings) | Project-wide simulation settings: a settings resource (`assets/settings/PhysicsSettings.json`, Game ▸ Project Settings). |

## `AudioSettings`

Project settings resource (`assets/settings/AudioSettings.json`, Game ▸
Project Settings in the editor): the master and bus volumes. Hot-reloads,
also during Play.

Scripts: `world.resource("AudioSettings")`, `world.set_resource("AudioSettings", { ... })`.

- **`master`** `number` (default `1.0`, range 0–2): Volume of everything.
- **`effects`** `number` (default `1.0`, range 0–2): Volume of the effects bus (one-shots).
- **`ambience`** `number` (default `1.0`, range 0–2): Volume of the ambience bus.
- **`music`** `number` (default `1.0`, range 0–2): Volume of the music bus.

## `Environment`

Sky, ambient light, fog, exposure and post-processing (ambient
occlusion, bloom, colour grading), atmosphere (haze, mist, quieting),
vignette and wind. A scene resource; the default is
`Environment::day`. Fields missing from a scene file take their
default values. Every value is a uniform: animating them (time of day)
never rebuilds a pipeline.

Scripts: `world.resource("Environment")`, `world.set_resource("Environment", { ... })`.

- **`sky_zenith`** `Color`: Sky colour straight up (linear).
- **`sky_horizon`** `Color`: Sky colour at the horizon (linear); also tints the fog.
- **`ground`** `Color`: Colour below the horizon and of light bounced up from the ground (linear).
- **`ambient_intensity`** `number` (default `1.0`, range 0–10): Multiplier for the hemisphere ambient light.
- **`sun_disc_size`** `number` (default `0.010471975430846214`, range 0–0.2, unit rad): Angular radius of the sun disc in radians.
- **`fog_density`** `number` (default `0.006000000052154064`, range 0–1, unit 1/m): Fog density per metre at `fog_base_height`. 0 disables fog.
- **`fog_height_falloff`** `number` (default `0.07999999821186066`, range 0–1, unit 1/m): How quickly fog thins out with height (per metre).
- **`fog_base_height`** `number` (default `0.0`, unit m): Height at which fog has its full density.
- **`exposure`** `number` (default `0.550000011920929`, range 0–16): Exposure multiplier applied before tone mapping.
- **`tonemapper`** `"AgX" | "AcesFitted" | "None" | "Neutral"` (default `"AgX"`): Tone-mapping operator.
- **`ambient_occlusion`** `{ enabled: boolean, intensity: number, radius: number, bias: number, power: number, direct_lighting: number }`: Screen-space ambient occlusion: darkens ambient light in creases, corners and where objects meet.
- **`bloom`** `{ enabled: boolean, intensity: number, scatter: number, threshold: number, knee: number }`: Soft glow around bright areas.
- **`color_grading`** `{ temperature: number, tint: number, contrast: number, saturation: number, shadows: vector, midtones: vector, highlights: vector, shadows_end: number, highlights_start: number, lift: vector, gamma: vector, gain: vector }`: White balance, contrast, saturation, shadows/midtones/highlights and lift/gamma/gain.
- **`sky`** `{ gradient: "Simple" | { Layered: { upper: Color?, below_horizon: Color? } }, sun_glow: number, sun_disc: number, horizon_glow: number, stars: number }`: Sky gradient style, sun glow and disc, horizon glow, stars.
- **`aerial_haze`** `{ enabled: boolean, color: Color, density: number, start_distance: number, max_opacity: number, sun_scatter: number, sky_height: number }`: Distance haze toward a colour, from a start distance, up to a maximum opacity (aerial perspective).
- **`height_mist`** `{ enabled: boolean, color: Color, top: number, bottom: number, max_opacity: number, near_fade: number }`: Mist pooling in a height band (a valley or cloud sea).
- **`distance_quieting`** `{ enabled: boolean, start: number, ["end"]: number, desaturate: number, contrast: number, tone: Color }`: Desaturation and contrast loss with distance, so the background stays quiet behind the foreground.
- **`vignette`** `{ intensity: number, smoothness: number, rounded: boolean }` (default `{"intensity":0.0,"smoothness":0.5,"rounded":false}`): Darkened image corners.
- **`wind`** `{ direction: vector, strength: number, gust_length: number, gust_speed: number }`: The global wind that materials with `wind` sway in.

## `PhysicsSettings`

Project-wide simulation settings: a settings resource
(`assets/settings/PhysicsSettings.json`, Game ▸ Project Settings).

Scripts: `world.resource("PhysicsSettings")`, `world.set_resource("PhysicsSettings", { ... })`.

- **`gravity`** `vector` (default `[0.0,-9.8100004196167,0.0]`, unit m/s²): Acceleration of dynamic bodies (times their `gravity_scale`).
- **`solver_iterations`** `number` (default `4`, range 1–32): Solver iterations per step: more make stacks and chains stiffer and cost more.
